data.long_meaning: In Christianity, the name Hands is a reminder of God's outstretched hands in creation and redemption. It can be a symbol of service, action, and devotion. The name Hands carries the meaning “Symbol of service and action” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hands usually hope their child will grow to embody symbol of service and action and live with faith, good character and purpose.
